brief: Our highest-yield opportunities are heavily concentrated in Brooklyn, driven by the 485-x tax exemption combined with Section 8 VPS rents on city-owned lots. Out of 1,271 scanned parcels, 918 pencil, with top Brooklyn sites showing exceptional cash-on-cash returns between 12.0% and 31.8%. Meanwhile, Bronx opportunities represent program-tier all-affordable ELLA/4% LIHTC plays yielding developer fees up to $333,039 but requiring competitive subsidy awards.
